description: Cryptographically secure, unbiased randomness: whole numbers between min and max (default 1 to 100), or random picks from a list of choices, one or up to 100 per call. Useful because language models are bad at being random: fair draws, sampling, shuffling decisions, and A/B assignment. Not charged for invalid options. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

choices.description: Optional list to pick from instead of a number range.

name: random_number
title: Secure random numbers in a range, or a random pick from a list
